checks.description: Health, exact empty state, and read purity
Unknown paths and methods are 404
Malformed JSON and non-object bodies are rejected atomically
Unknown operations, missing and extra fields are invalid
Identifier boundaries, case sensitivity and object-like names
Quantity and timestamp type/range boundaries
Item-list shape, duplicates, extra fields and size are validated
Missing entities and invalid revisions have specified precedence
Receipts accumulate independently across SKU and warehouse
Inventory and order lines use ASCII lexical order
Stock cap accepts maximum and rejects overflow with no audit effect
Unknown stock failure does not leave phantom rows or orders
Reservation, shipment and cancellation conserve physical stock
Zero stock rows remain visible after full shipment
Multi-SKU reservation rolls back an earlier successful line
Partial shipment, cancellation and closure preserve line totals
Closed IDs cannot be reused and duplicate detection precedes expiry
Stale revisions reject shipments, cancellations and returns
Unknown and excess line quantities fail atomically
Partial returns restore original warehouse without reopening orders
Cumulative returns cannot exceed shipments or include cancelled stock
Multi-line return overflow rolls back earlier restoration
Dispatch removes source stock without crediting destination
Dispatch cannot consume reserved stock and same-warehouse fails
Multi-SKU dispatch is atomic on insufficient stock
Partial receipt and cancellation close transfer with correct stock
Received or cancelled quantities cannot be processed twice
Transfer stale revisions and duplicate IDs are protected
Destination overflow rolls back all receipt lines
Source overflow and unknown transfer lines fail atomically
Expiration occurs at the exact boundary and releases once
Clock cannot move backwards; new orders require future expiry
Expiry preserves shipments and increments each affected revision once
Closed orders retain revisions at expiry; returns remain possible
Bulk expiry sorts IDs and leaves later reservations intact
Reads and restarts do not advance logical time or expire orders
Retry receipt returns exact response with one stock/audit effect
